Title: Azure Application Gateway analytics will be retired on 29 February 2024

Body.Content:
Because Azure Monitor Network Insights workbook enhances your troubleshooting experience, we will be retiring Azure Application Gateway analytics solution on 29 February 2024. We encourage you to start using Azure Monitor Network Insights workbook to take advantage of the new capabilities. 

Action required 

To continue monitoring your Application Gateway resources, transition to Azure Monitor Network insights workbook before 29 February 2024. 

More Information 

If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, please create a support request.
